snippet.title: O-Jay! - SAGE TRAILER
snippet.description:
O-Jay! is an action platformer that is centered around movement. Play as Bryson, as he goes around his own house to find his dad's broken Shrink Ray to repair it, and put an end to those dastardly O-Jay Pouches!

Play the demo!
https://www.sonicfangameshq.com/forums/showcase/o-jay-sage-2026-demo.2917/

SONG - ONE TW3NTY F1VE by @ColourheadMusic

#indiegame #indie #indieplatformer #sonic #sage #rayman
